opportunities.classification: deterministic correctness bug; minimum Runtime maintenance permitted by AGENTS.md
opportunities.what: Make default step instructionSources describe only final admitted project blocks, with content hashes and ordering matching model request rendering. Keep raw discovery events distinct from admission.
opportunities.how: In ContextController derive project sources from built.blocks where source=project, using final block.content/path in final block order; keep system source. Do not filter discovery telemetry globally or enable S2. Keep architecture and ToolOrchestrator boundary unchanged.

acceptance: Baseline-red same Harness request/snapshot fixture for injection denied and budget dropped
Candidate rejected/dropped documents contribute zero project sources and do not change instruction fingerprint when only denied content changes
Admitted document changes request and next-step fingerprint; hashes use rendered content and order
Discovery remains observable even when denial occurs; context injection event and security gate preserved

opportunities.classification: deterministic context budget correctness defect plus measured avoidable full-file capture
opportunities.what: Bound default AGENTS.md captured body to configured byte cap, including single long ASCII/Unicode lines, and bound FS capture work to cap plus UTF-8 lookahead.
opportunities.how: Keep existing default ancestor/subtree policy and metadata. Replace full readFile with bounded regular-file capture; truncate at whole-line boundary when available, otherwise a valid UTF-8 code-point prefix. Preserve sizeBytes and explicit truncation marker. Agree whether legacy marker is outside cap (minimal compatibility) or included (stronger hard cap) before fixing tests; no automatic S2 promotion.
acceptance: Actual FS capture is bounded by cap+4 instead of file size on large files
Single-line ASCII and Unicode bodies obey cap, do not introduce replacement characters, and are admitted by the 500-token actual pipeline
Multi-line prefix and small-file exact bytes preserved; truncation metadata truthful
No symlink regression, no invalid cwd swallowing, no change to root/nested/cwd precedence
Test cap=0, tiny positive cap, boundary exactly cap, line-aligned and partial UTF-8 cut; account explicit marker cost in criterion
opportunities.risk: Legacy task CTX-001 explicitly records first long line as a residual exception. Eliminating it is an intentional improvement, not evidence that all earlier tests failed. Existing 30-byte Unicode test constrains marker semantics; keep compatibility or explicitly update contract. Detection scans bounded rendered content, as it already does for ordinary multi-line truncation.
